ownerContext: The mailbox owner, responsible for their own work and follow-up.
organizationContext: A business mailbox. Customers buy from us; suppliers sell to us.

customer_sales.description: Sales to our customers: our products, selling prices, customer orders/POs, capacity, samples, rushes and forecasts. Excludes our purchases from suppliers, even when their message calls us a customer.

customer_accounting.description: Active accounting work for sales to our customers: payments, credits, invoice questions, billing discrepancies, collections or unpaid balances, including internal discussion of them. Routine outgoing shipping invoices with no accounting issue use pack_invoice_confirmation. Excludes receipts for products or services we purchased.

supply_chain.description: Active human conversation about our purchases from suppliers, materials, freight or logistics, including purchase-related supplier paperwork requests. Excludes routine transaction documents and unsolicited offers trying to win our business.

internal_production.description: Internal production, scheduling, WIP, quality or shipping status, including daily delivery-value dashboards and shipping performance against goals. These reports belong here even when generated automatically.

internal_maintenance.description: Machine issues, repair requests, maintenance parts and maintenance purchasing requests.

pack_invoice_confirmation.description: Routine transaction documents: packing slips, vendor invoices, outgoing shipping invoices with no accounting issue, order/shipment confirmations, tracking and paid receipts for products or services we purchased, including software subscriptions. A forwarded purchase receipt remains in this category when the receipt is the main purpose.

it_systems.description: IT support, account/access, software, websites, integrations or infrastructure; use for substantive IT issues.

automated.description: Other automated operational notifications, alerts, reports, digests and completed-system notifications without a more specific workflow. A table or report format alone does not prove automation; internal production/shipping reports use internal_production.

newsletter_marketing.description: Newsletters, promotions, surveys, solicitations, industry news and sales outreach, including unsolicited freight or supplier pitches seeking our business without an active order or requested quote.

other.description: Business purpose outside these categories. Not a substitute for uncertainty.
